lines.en: I walk head down; the top of my skull is thick.
The forest floor is full of roots.

lines.zh: 我两条腿走近，四只成群。
lines.en: I walk on two legs, four of us together.
Our marks are on the bark.

lines.zh: 我把头往树干上顶了一下。
lines.en: I push my head against a trunk once.
That is how I practise.
A herd-mate walks to my rear flank.

lines.zh: 这片林子我们走了很多遍。
lines.en: We have walked this wood many times.

lines.zh: 落下的果子被我们踩碎。
lines.en: Fallen fruit crushes under our feet.
I step over a fallen log.
The brush ahead is pushed apart.
I swing my head as I walk.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边听着脚步声。
lines.en: I listen to the footsteps as I walk.

lines.zh: 我们四个挤在一条小道上。
lines.en: The four of us squeeze along one trail.
The top of my skull is hard as a hammer.
A hard dome rings my skull.
I rake the fallen leaves to my feet.

lines.zh: 同伴靠过来蹭了我一下。
lines.en: A herd-mate leans in and nudges me.
I nudge back.
Birds call in the wood.
This wood is very still.
I look up above.
A herd-mate rubs its crown on bark.
I listen to it.
The leaves rustle.
Wind comes from deep in the wood.
There is an old scar on my crown.

lines.zh: 一只松鼠跑过去，我没动。
lines.en: A squirrel runs by; I do not move.
You stand between two trees.
The four of us face you together.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着你的拳头。
lines.en: My eyes are fixed on your fist.
I lower my head and point my crown at you.
That is not a charge at you.
Only so you know.
You gave half a step.
That will do as well.
Your shoulders are broad.
That would suit a charge better.

lines.zh: 我一点也不急，我的头骨够厚。
lines.en: No hurry at all; my skull is thick.
You have softened your steps.
I shake the broken leaves off my head.
The dome still holds.
My thick skull rings.
My dome is buzzing from the hit.
The dome has dented a little.
I hit a tree and dazed myself first.
I brace against a trunk a moment.
I stand behind a tree, breathing hard.
The crown still feels hot.
My breathing is a little heavy.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，我四个都在看。
lines.en: All four of us are looking at what you hold.
It smells a little sweet.
Set it on the ground.
All four of us are watching.
You set the fruit on the leaves.
A herd-mate got there first.
I bite another.

lines.zh: 你手上那甜味散得很慢。
lines.en: That sweetness on your hands spreads slowly.
You broke the fruit open.
The juice smell thickens at once.
You bumped my belly.
I swayed and did not fall.
My herd-mates moved aside.
You passed between us.
You pushed me back half a step.
That rarely happens to me.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，走到树的另一边。
lines.en: I go around you to the other side of the tree.
You are wedged between two of us.
We make one body's width.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的手肘，退开了。
lines.en: I hit your elbow and pulled back.
We do not split up this season.
What you ask must wait a while.
Only one pair among the four of us.
It is not my turn yet.

lines.zh: 我头上这玩意不讨人喜欢。
lines.en: This thing on my head wins no one.

lines.zh: 林子里的伴都是随群的。
lines.en: Our mates come with the herd.
All four of us are still young.

lines.zh: 这林子太挤，不好说这个。
lines.en: This wood is too crowded for that talk.
We are not there yet.

lines.zh: 我们这群里没有那样的事。
lines.en: There is none of that in this herd.
There is a fruit on the ground.
I pick it up and bite once.
It tastes a little astringent.
I swallowed it anyway.
It crumbled in my bite.
Juice smears my snout.
I bury what is left in the leaves.
It is stuck between roots.
I butt the roots apart.
I butt it under the leaves.
You have walked into our wood.
The trees make the way narrow.
You cannot retreat quickly here.

lines.zh: 我把厚头顶低下去，对着你的方向。
lines.en: I lower my thick skull toward you.
My crown is level with your waist.
This will put you down.
I will ask once more.
Are you going or not?
All our crowns face you.
Which will you pick?
It makes no difference.
You are backing away.
The trees behind will not give way.

lines.zh: 你在这里退不快，树把路堵住了。
lines.en: You cannot retreat fast here; the trees block the way.
I circle through the trees.
My herd-mates take the other side.
You have one way out.
We have blocked it.
My head is already lowered.
You are slowest when turning.
I go a step and stop.
You take a step and look back.
At this rate you tire first.
The light in this wood is dim.
The tree shadows hide my body.
Turn and I pull back.
Turning is the slowest thing.
We have changed positions.
Now you are between two of us.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压碎了一片蕨叶。
lines.en: Your boot just crushed a fern frond.

lines.zh: 你后面是我们的第四个。
lines.en: The fourth of us is behind you.
I drop my head and charge.
My crown hits your chest.
You are knocked backward.
My neck jolts.

lines.zh: 我头顶这块骨头，撞完要缓。
lines.en: This dome of mine needs a beat after ramming.
A herd-mate adds a shove from the flank.
I butt my crown at your knee.
You fold at the waist.
I step back and butt once more.
You are knocked flat against a tree.

lines.zh: 厚脑袋一低，就是这一撞。
lines.en: Head down—this is the blow.
The trunk cracks.
I hit your bracer.
It bounced me off.
My head is still hard.
It numbed your arm.

lines.zh: 森林里有树倒下去的声音。
lines.en: A tree crashes somewhere in the wood.
That was us.
I come out beside a stump.
The leaf litter is thick and soft.
This wood belongs to the four of us.
The trunks bear old impact marks.
Left from last year.
This year's are still fresh.

lines.zh: 倒下的那棵树还冒着汁。
lines.en: The fallen tree still bleeds sap.

lines.zh: 森林的边缘有一片空地。
lines.en: There is a clearing at the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我们走得很慢，林子里太挤。
lines.en: We walk slowly; the wood is crowded.

lines.zh: 落叶被我们踩得哗哗响。
lines.en: The leaves rustle under us.
The canopy shuts the light out.
My skull is the hammer.
The other three are behind.
I stop once at the front.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我撞开灌木。
lines.en: Fire catches my back and I crash through the brush.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下去，撞在树根上。
lines.en: Rolled down the slope into a tree root.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我朝有光的地方游。
lines.en: Water pours in; I swim for the light.
The blast throws up every leaf.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎在我的肩上。
lines.en: Something sharp sticks in my shoulder.
That light numbs my crown.

lines.zh: 饿得我撞树的力气都没有。
lines.en: Too hungry even to butt a tree.

lines.zh: 雷打在我头顶，我跪了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my crown and I buckle.
The leaves under me are gone.
